summary: A professor defending a local law remembers teaching people abroad how residents got it passed.
realLife: Susan Flader told the council she had described the local ordinance to overseas audiences as an example of civic participation and urged members to improve it.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: speaker history and ordinance status.

turns.writesBack: The next account includes the contested effort to amend it.
